title: Security Assurance PRD Addendum — SAML Federation Rules, Role Provenance, Audit Stream SLAs & KMS Operator Runbook
creator: Aisha Patel
scope_changes: Addendum to PRD: tighten SAML assertion lifetime policy, require role provenance metadata in all RBAC tokens, introduce audit-stream delivery SLA (max 60s to customer SIEM), and clarify KMS operator procedures for key rotation in air-gapped/on-prem installs.
description: This document is an addendum to the Security & Compliance PRD for Private deployments. It defines concrete acceptance criteria, a sign-off checklist, and operational runbook items for SSO/SAML federation, RBAC role provenance, audit streaming guarantees, and KMS/HSM operator tasks. It exists to remove ambiguity surfaced during engineering and security reviews and to provide a tangible set of testable gates for onboarding customers with strict audit and key custody requirements.
goals: Define minimal SAML federation parameters (assertion lifetime, audience restrictions, signature algorithms) required for Private deployments
Specify RBAC role provenance: how roles are assigned, recorded in audit logs, and propagated across federation chains
Establish audit-stream SLAs and delivery modes (push to customer SIEM, syslog, or secure S3), including retention and schema versioning
Document KMS/HSM operator runbook steps for key generation, rotation, emergency rollback, and escrow in air-gapped installs
Produce a clear, signable checklist for security, product, and engineering to accept customer onboarding
acceptance_criteria: SSO/SAML: Default assertion lifetime <= 5 minutes; configurable down to 1 minute. SAML responses must contain audience restriction matching customer entity ID and must be signed with SHA-256 or stronger.

SAML metadata: Service Provider (SP) and Identity Provider (IdP) metadata parsing must support multiple certificate tags and validate expiration dates; automated PRD test harness will import sample IdP metadata and validate signature chain.

RBAC: All role grants in the Private control plane include 'role_provenance' fields with values: {source: 'IdP'|'Admin'|'ProvisioningAPI', issued_at: ISO8601, requester_id: opaque UUID} and this field is exported to audit logs.

Audit streaming: Events related to authentication, role changes, key operations, and model serving fallbacks must be streamed to configured endpoints within 60 seconds of occurrence under normal load; system provides backpressure metrics and retry with exponential backoff for transient failures.

Audit schema: Event payloads conform to schema v2.1 (fields: timestamp, event_type, principal, role_provenance, resource, outcome, trace_id). A compatibility shim must be available for customers on v2.0 for a 90-day migration window.

KMS/HSM: Key creation, rotation, and destruction operations must produce an auditable event with trace_id and be reversible only with multi-operator approval as configured in customer policy. On air-gapped installs, documented manual escrow procedure must be present and tested.

Operational tests: End-to-end test that provisions a sampler IdP, performs SAML login, grants a role via provisioning API, triggers a key rotation, and verifies audit events reached a test SIEM endpoint within SLA.
Documentation: Runbook and operator checklists published in Confluence; release notes include migration steps and customer-facing changes. All docs linked in this issue.
signoff_checklist: Security review completed and signed by Security Eng lead (name + date)
Privacy review for audit payloads completed and acknowledged by Privacy team
E2E automated test added to ci/integration with deterministic IdP simulator
KMS/HSM runbook validated in staging by on-call operator (runbook version + date)
RBAC role_provenance field schema approved and sample payload included in API docs
Audit streaming SLA verified under 75th percentile load via performance harness
Documentation checklist completed: runbook, public customer KB, API example snippets
Stakeholder signoff: Product Manager, Security, Engineering Lead, and Customer Success
implementation_notes: Engineering to add 'role_provenance' to token issuance flow and ensure propagation across microservices via trace header
Add a SAML metadata ingestion validator tool to admin console to pre-validate IdP metadata before onboarding
Audit streamer service to expose retry metrics and dead-letter queue visibility in Console
KMS operator procedures to include HSM quorum steps, sample CLI commands, and emergency rollback checklist
Fallback behavior: when audit stream target is unreachable, events must be persisted to encrypted local store and retried; persisting store retention capped per customer policy
risks: Long-tail incompatibilities with customer IdPs requiring nonstandard SAML bindings could increase onboarding time
Audit streaming SLA depends on customer-side endpoint availability and network path; may require explicit network tests during onboarding
Air-gapped KMS escrow procedures are manual and risk operator error unless training is enforced
Adding role_provenance increases token size and may require minor protocol adjustments for legacy integrations
testing_plan: Automated integration: IdP simulator + provisioning API + KMS emulator across pipeline (green on CI)
Performance: Audit streamer load test at 2x expected peak for a sample mid-market tenant; measure P50/P95/P99 delivery latency
Security fuzzing: malformed SAML assertions and metadata stress tests
Manual runbook drills: operator executes key rotation and emergency rollback in staging with at least two operators present
notes: Stakeholder meeting 2026-02-25: security asked for tightened assertion lifetimes and explicit role provenance. Engineering requested an additional 2 sprints for KMS runbook automation work.
Customer success requested an option to receive audit events via signed S3 uploads as alternative delivery mode; added as non-blocking enhancement
Legal provided feedback on minimum retention for audit events; default set to 365 days unless customer overrides
